item.title: Bulletin updated at 04:50 HKT 13/Jul/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The subtropical ridge is expected to extend westwards and affect southeastern China. The weather will be persistently very hot apart from a few showers over the region in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, a broad area of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to the central and southern parts of the South China Sea and move towards the central to northern parts of Vietnam gradually. Under the influence of a broad trough of low pressure, showers will increase over the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week.
